tolerance.note: every frame bitwise (running FNV-1a of the probe + pools); rows locate the first divergent field

setup.heliFormula: t = frame/60; x = x0 + ax·sin(t·wx), y = y0 + ay·sin(t·wy), z = z0 + az·sin(t·wz); ctx.heli = {position, altitude: y, alive: frame < deadFrom, rotorRPM: rpm}

camera.note: camera world position = heli + offset; world direction constant

setup.order: new Weather(ctx) (when weather), new Ocean(ctx); heli/camera of frame 0; actions of frame -1; weather.init(); ocean.init(); per frame f: time (dt, t += dt, frame++), heli/camera, pre actions, weather.update(dt), ocean.update(dt), post actions, ocean._lateUpload(), probe
setup.renderer: stub: EXT_color_buffer_float when memory; render(stampScene) records the frame's instance attributes (aA, aB, aC first count·4 each); clear() counts target clears

data.hashNote: h0 = 2166136261; per frame h = fnv1a32(h, probe row), then each of: spl.x, spl.z, spl.t0, spl.r, spl.s, gl.x, gl.z, gl.r, gl.i, gl.c, memory aA, aB, aC (full, [] without memory), the frame's stamps (aA ++ aB ++ aC of the drawn instances)
